hard_target: One whole actual proper-coefficient arrow and exact full-source lifting interface for the original rank4 carrier.

actual_positive_proper_arrow.finite_input: Existing actual compatible M_Bn inMat2(B_n), detp, canonical proper cohomological basis.
actual_positive_proper_arrow.coefficient_map: t=r-1; q_s=(2r+1)^2; u_s=(r+1)(2r-1)^2; B_n to A/p^n at each finite level.
actual_positive_proper_arrow.completed_matrix: Entrywise limit Mhat inMat2(Ahat), detp; Gtheta=Mhat^(-T) inGL2(Rhat).
actual_positive_proper_arrow.not_used: No localization/inverse-limit exchange; no guessed map from Zp[[t]] into Ahat.

elementary_completion_lemma.basis: 1,r,r^2,... and(r-a)^(-j),a=+/-1,+/-1/2,j>=1; integral unique partial fractions because pairwise differences are p-units.
elementary_completion_lemma.completion: Restricted p-adic coefficient families in that basis.
elementary_completion_lemma.origin: r=0 evaluation is bounded; no boundary Laurent-ring identification.

full_source_kernel_component.input: Exact integral Q(0)=0 with d=2f_prime/f+Q_prime from the old kernel proof.
full_source_kernel_component.all_scalar_row_solutions: k_prime=a d-lambda dpsi iff a=p lambda; then k=lambda bpsi+c with c inK.
full_source_kernel_component.sigma: One coefficient action; sigma(g)=g is not assumed.

remaining_two_entry_obstruction.class: Original selected block class F=[[G,0,0],[0,a,0],[h1,h2,k,lambda]], a,lambda inK^x.
remaining_two_entry_obstruction.exact_iff: Full F in this block class exists iff U=lambda V for some lambda inK^x.
remaining_two_entry_obstruction.source_primitive: An actual h proving the quotient equality must be supplied; defining U,V does not establish it.
remaining_two_entry_obstruction.zero_cases: V=U=0 allows any nonzero lambda; V=0,U!=0 none; V!=0 allows at most one nonzero scalar ratio, and U=0 none.

lift_compatibility.input: Previously proved full T fromtheta pullback tophi pullback; no reproof.
lift_compatibility.cokernel_map: [b] inH_phi goes to[b T_D] inH_theta; L_theta(hT_D)=L_phi(h)T_D.
lift_compatibility.source_classes: The map sends Uphi toUtheta andVphi toVtheta using the full bottom proper row ofT.
lift_compatibility.weak_version: Requires the actual proper G to be weak; no completed-to-weak primitive transfer is assumed.

unproved: The actual source class equality, any firstfullF, weakmembership ofthepropermatrix/sourceprimitive, fullrank4 geometric/sourceaction realization, originalfunctional/Y.
